Name: Beerah, Son of Baal
Summary: Son of Baal and prince of the Reubenites, carried away captive by Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:6: Son of Baal and prince of the Reubenites, carried away captive by Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Beerah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
